import zipfile, re
z=zipfile.ZipFile('inputs/offer_letter_template.docx')
for n in z.namelist():
    if n.endswith('.xml') and ('document' in n or 'header' in n or 'footer' in n):
        data=z.read(n).decode('utf-8')
        # find uppercase tokens (placeholders), stripping tags to see text
        txt=re.sub(r'<[^>]+>','',data)
        toks=set(re.findall(r'[A-Z_]{3,}', txt))
        if toks:
            print(n, sorted(toks))
EOF

import zipfile, re
z=zipfile.ZipFile('inputs/offer_letter_template.docx')
doc=z.read('word/document.xml').decode('utf-8')
# locate IF_RELOCATION region
i=doc.find('IF_RELOCATION')
# find a window; but tokens split across runs. Let's get text of each w:t
# Print paragraphs with text joined
paras=re.split(r'(?=<w:p[ >])', doc)
for p in paras:
    ts=re.findall(r'<w:t[^>]*>(.*?)</w:t>', p, re.S)
    txt=''.join(ts)
    if re.search(r'[A-Z_]{3,}', txt) or 'IF_RELOCATION' in txt:
        print(repr(txt))
EOF

cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import zipfile, re
z=zipfile.ZipFile('output/offer_letter_filled.docx')
def text(n):
    d=z.read(n).decode('utf-8')
    paras=re.split(r'(?=<w:p[ >])', d)
    out=[]
    for p in paras:
        ts=re.findall(r'<w:t[^>]*>(.*?)</w:t>', p, re.S)
        if ts: out.append(''.join(ts))
    return out

print("=== document.xml ===")
for t in text('word/document.xml'):
    print(repr(t))
print("=== header1 ===", text('word/header1.xml'))
print("=== footer1 ===", text('word/footer1.xml'))
print("=== header6 ===", text('word/header6.xml'))
print("=== footer6 ===", text('word/footer6.xml'))

# verify no leftover placeholders anywhere
import re as R
bad=False
for n in z.namelist():
    if n.endswith('.xml'):
        d=z.read(n).decode('utf-8')
        m=R.findall(r'\{\{[A-Z_]+\}\}', d)
        if m: print("LEFTOVER in",n,m); bad=True
print("No leftovers" if not bad else "LEFTOVERS FOUND")
EOF
